items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: No, I never did see Honoré or Peter. But, I do know that he played in a lot of the top brass bands like that.

ctx.x: Never did see him out on the street then.

No, I never did see Honoré or Peter. But, I do know that he played in a lot of the top brass bands like that. Yeah. I think it was Excelsior one band he played with before he left there. Yeah, I didn't even know. Because I had all the caps, he left me all the caps at the house. Well, he had the old caps.
